item.title: RFP 521197 - Environmental Investigations and Abatement Monitoring for Asbestos, Lead, Mold, and Soil Contaminant
item.description:
Housing Authority | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2027-01-05 In plain English (machine-written): The New York City Housing Authority is seeking proposals from consultants for environmental investigations and abatement monitoring for asbestos, lead, mold and soil contaminants, with up to four agreements to be awarded, with responses due Jan. 5, 2027.

NYCHA intends to enter up to four (4) agreements (the Agreement) with the selected Proposer(s) (the Selected Proposer(s) or the Consultant(s)) to provide the Services. Each Agreement will be an Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Agreement.

If a Proposer has separately been awarded an agreement by NYCHA for Services (similar to the Services or otherwise), such award shall not, in of itself, disqualify the Proposer from being awarded an Agreement pursuant to this RFP. Such award shall, however, be a factor in the evaluation criteria described in Section V of this RFP with respect to the Proposers staffing capacity and ability to perform the Services if the Proposer is awarded an Agreement.

item.title: FHA Homes Homeownership First Request for Expressions of Interest
item.description:
Housing Authority | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2027-02-18 In plain English (machine-written): The New York City Housing Authority is seeking expressions of interest from development teams to rehabilitate and sell 1-4 family properties in its FHA Homes portfolio to existing residents, with responses due Feb. 18, 2027.

The Real Estate Development Department (REDD) of the New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA or the Authority) is excited to announce the FHA Homes: Homeownership First Request for Expressions of Interest (FHA Homes Homeownership First RFEI) to seek proposals from Development Teams to rehabilitate and sell to existing residents occupied 1-4-family properties in NYCHAs FHA Homes portfolio. Interested development team applicants must submit qualifying materials by February 18, 2027. All RFEI materials will be available on NYCHAs website.  The Pre-Submission Conference will be held virtually December 8, 2026 at 10:00 A.M. To RSVP for the Pre-Submission Conference, please follow the instructions detailed within the RFEI.  NYCHA additionally recommends that Applicants submit, via webform or email, written questions to following the instructions detailed within the RFEI by no later than 5:00pm on December 15, 2026.  Applicants will be permitted to ask additional questions at the Pre-Submission Conference. item.title: SMD_A&CM_RFQ #518113 - Elevator Rehabilitation and Maintenance for Haber Houses, Coney Island Site 8 and ODwyer Gardens
item.description:
Housing Authority | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-12-16 In plain English (machine-written): The New York City Housing Authority is seeking competitive sealed bids, due Dec. 16, 2026, for the rehabilitation, maintenance and servicing of 21 elevators at Haber Houses, O'Dwyer Gardens and Coney Island I Site 8.

The Work under this Contract (RFQ No. 518113 Elevator Package) consists of the rehabilitation, modernization, maintenance, and service of six (6) elevators at Haber Houses, thirteen (13) elevators at O'Dwyer Gardens, and two (2) elevators at Coney Island I Site 8. The Contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, supervision, and incidental services necessary to complete the Work in accordance with the Contract Documents.

The scope includes, but is not limited to, the removal and replacement of existing elevator systems and the furnishing and installation of new elevator equipment, including machines, controls, hoistway components, car enclosures, doors, communication systems, safety devices, and associated electrical components. The Work also includes testing, inspection, commissioning, training, and coordination with NYCHA and other trades, including separate electrical and abatement packages.

The Contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, materials, equipment, and incidentals necessary to identify, manage, and remediate environmental hazards including, but not limited to, lead, asbestos, mold, and other hazardous materials in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

item.title: SMPD_PS_RFP 523229 - The Development and Implementation of Department of Housing and Urban Development Required Training for National Standards for the Physical Inspection of Real Estate (NSPIRE) and Housing Opportunity Through Modernization Act (HOTMA)
item.description:
Housing Authority | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-11-10 In plain English (machine-written): The New York City Housing Authority is seeking proposals by Nov. 10, 2026, from firms to develop and deliver training for its property management and central office staff on federal HUD inspection standards (NSPIRE) and the Housing Opportunity Through Modernization Act (HOTMA), covering both public housing and housing choice vouchers.

New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA) seeks proposals from firms with expertise in National Standards for the Physical Inspection of Real Estate (NSPIRE) and Housing Opportunity Through Modernization Act (HOTMA) training (the Proposers) to provide NYCHA with NSPIRE and HOTMA specific training for NYCHAs property management and central office staff, on both the Public Housing side and the Housing Choice Voucher side. This will consist of training sessions (each a Session) and testing materials for the sessions.  The topics for NSPIRE included in the Sessions must be customized to ensure NYCHAs staff is able to (a) comply with the rules and regulations set forth in HUDs NSPIRE program (b) conduct visual  inspections of Public Housing Developments in accordance with HUDs Uniform Physical Condition Standards (UPCS), and (c) identify and repair deficiencies found pre, during, and post NSPIRE inspections in accordance with industry standards. The Sessions must also require participants to take an exam (the Exam), the passing of which will provide the participant with …
